title: Mud is Fun
lines: Mud is on Tim. Mud is on the cat.
Dad can not nap. Dad is up.
Not in the mud, Tim! Dad, it is fun!
Dad did sit in the mud!
Mud is on Dad. Mud is on the cap.
Tim is not sad. Dad is not mad.
Mud in the sun is fun.

questions.ask: Who sat down in the mud at the end?
questions.listenFor: Dad. The story says it plainly. If your child says Tim, point to the line and read it together.

questions.ask: What did Dad say before he sat down?
questions.listenFor: Not in the mud, Tim. You want the idea that Dad said no first and then changed his mind - that change is the whole story.

questions.ask: Do you think Dad had fun in the mud? Tell me why you think so.
questions.listenFor: There is no wrong answer. Listen for a reason from the story, like nobody was mad at the end, or he sat down himself.
